notes: The Albums tab’s ⋮ menu no longer reaches into a playlist. It was drawing the actions of whichever playlist you had open behind the tab — “Clear playlist” (which emptied every album of its songs, while wearing a playlist label), “Delete playlist” (which deleted that playlist by name) and a DJ Mode toggle that flipped DJ mode for it. Those three are playlist-scoped, so they now only appear when a playlist is actually on screen, and the Albums menu is album actions only

“Export albums” exports your albums. It was calling the playlist export, which zipped whatever playlist was open behind the tab and even named the file after it — so exporting your albums handed you a .zip of one playlist. It now ships the tracks of the albums you made, with the album grouping included so importing the .zip rebuilds the albums, and the confirmation says how many albums and songs it is about to write. Nothing from a playlist is included

“Download to phone” and “Download crossfaded mix” already worked from the album view (they take the songs you are looking at), and still do — every song of your hand-made albums, and nothing tied to a playlist. Your playlists are untouched by anything done from Albums: the suite proves them byte-for-byte unchanged
